tagline: Elite top end, a robot bottom, and a promise to be kind.
file: A star at running back and almost nothing else. Made his last real pick in round 6 and let the CPU draft the remaining seventeen rounds.
The positive attitude. He promised to be positive and kind through the whole draft and has been quiet since Week 2.
YesChef23, who needles him in the restaurant arc, and Sarge71, who beat him by 1.34 in Week 4.
Hades9mm in Week 5, and whether Gibbs gets a second scorer before the 0-4 hardens.

2026.headline: 0-4 by 1.34, and the league's last winless team
story: Painty69 took Jahmyr Gibbs at 1.01, then McCaffrey and Barkley back to back, and then stopped. The last real pick was in round 6, and the CPU made the remaining seventeen, tying him with Johnny4Skins at eighteen autopicks. The feed has since shown him moving Sarratt, Aiyuk and Klubnik, three of the robot's choices.

He is 0-4 with 497.14 points. The losses were by 12.7, 32.3, 4.7 and now 1.34 to Sarge71, with Joe Burrow leading Week 4 at 25.72 and 46.0 points left on the bench. Gibbs has been excellent, but Week 4 shows the problem: even a good lineup loses when the bench is carrying more than the margin.

The silence is the other story. Four of the five votes in the Issue 4 poll said he stays in the bottom three, and he did not say a word in this log. The rivalry with YesChef23 gave the restaurant arc a result, but the desk's view is simpler: a top-end roster with a robot bottom, and a manager who left in the middle. He picks 7th on MAXPF.
takes: Gibbs did his job. Everyone else did not.
Positive and kind, right up until the robot took over.
